example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার সম্পত্তি কুক্ষিগত করে ফেলেছে।
দলের নেতা ক্ষমতা কুক্ষিগত করার পর সবাই তার অধীনে এসেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He has completely absorbed the property into his control.
After the party leader took full possession of power, everyone came under his authority.
note: Idiom implies total internalization or seizure, often in contexts of power or ownership.
